# Healthcare Data Exchange

> A synthetic research consent case for an exchange data steward, with a pilot-cost decision for the operations director and a technical evidence guide for the same request.

## Business case

- [Privacy desk intake](https://safetymp.github.io/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/#research-request) follows Anna Mueller’s research, treatment and derivative requests, the requesting team, purpose and patient consent.
- [Pilot economics](https://safetymp.github.io/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/#pilot-costs) compares matched reviewer time, eligible volume and first-year cost.
- [Selected request evidence](https://safetymp.github.io/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/#technical/research/withheld/consent/selected) compares two synthetic consent trials and traces the authorized fields.
- [Publication evidence](https://safetymp.github.io/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/#policy-provenance) compares a pinned mirror pointer with the published policy bundle.

Browser results are illustrative. Endpoint enforcement and timing require separate observations at each destination.
